description:
This Planning Statement has been prepared in support of a retrospective planning application for the retention of an existing outdoor grill structure located within the private rear garden associated with Flat 1, 22 Cardigan Road, Richmond.

The proposal is for the structure to remain in place and to be used solely for occasional private domestic cooking by the occupants of the property. It will not be used for any commercial purpose, business activity or food preparation for sale.

The applicant has also committed to using the structure responsibly and considerately, having regard to the proximity of neighbouring residential properties. In particular, the applicant will seek to:

Limit the frequency of use to reasonable levels consistent with normal domestic enjoyment of a private garden;
Keep noise associated with the use to a minimum;
Avoid unnecessary disturbance to neighbouring occupiers;
Use the structure only for private domestic purposes; and
Be considerate of neighbouring residents when using the structure.

The proposed use is therefore considered to be ancillary to, and compatible with, the established residential use of the property.

The applicant respectfully notes that occasional outdoor cooking is an ordinary and established form of domestic activity associated with the enjoyment of a private residential garden.

The proposed retention of the structure does not introduce a commercial cooking use or materially intensify the residential use of the property. The applicant’s intention is to use the structure occasionally for private domestic cooking, in a manner comparable to the use of other domestic outdoor cooking equipment.

The applicant understands and respects the Council’s concerns regarding smoke and odour and will use the structure responsibly and considerately, having regard to neighbouring occupiers. 

The applicant also notes that the existence of the fixed structure does not, in itself, create an intention to undertake more frequent or intensive outdoor cooking than would otherwise be reasonably expected as part of the normal enjoyment of a private garden. The applicant’s commitment is to use the structure only for occasional domestic purposes and to avoid unnecessary disturbance to neighbouring residents.
